errors.debuggingNotEnabled: Could not connect to the SDB Daemon. Set the Host PC IP in Developer mode to 127.0.0.1 (Apps, then 12345). Then hold the power button till you see the Samsung logo. On a Frame TV, a short press only switches to Art Mode.
errors.stillChecking: Still checking the Developer mode settings. Try again in a few seconds.

installStatus.moduleEnabled: TizenTube is enabled. Open TizenBrew to start it.

resigning.resigningRequiredDesc:
Since Tizen 7, all packages must be resigned with a Samsung Certificate.
Please scan the QR code to sign in to your Samsung account and then copy the response JSON you get after signing in.
resigning.resigningRequiredPCDesc:
Since Tizen 7, all packages must be resigned with a Samsung Certificate.
Please click the button below to sign in to your Samsung account.
resigning.resigningRequiredAccessInfo: After copying the JSON response, go into http://{{ip}}:4794 and paste it into the input field and press the "Submit" button.
resigning.resigningDeviceSameNetwork: Make sure your device is on the same network as your TV.

installer.installingAgain: TizenBrew Installer is installed as an USB Demo Package. It will now be reinstalled as a normal package.
installer.alreadyInstalled: TizenBrew Installer as an USB Demo Package is installed. You can now uninstall it.

installerDesktop.sdbConnectionRefused: Could not connect to the SDB Daemon. Make sure that the TV is on and that the IP is correct.
installerDesktop.sdbConnectionReset: Could not connect to the SDB Daemon. Either you haven't set the Host PC IP to this device's IP, or you didn't restart the TV properly. Hold the power button till you see the Samsung logo to restart the TV.

receive.title: Receive from computer
receive.description: Install an app from a computer on the same network. The Host PC IP can stay 127.0.0.1.
receive.wrongCode: Wrong pairing code. You can find it on the TV under Receive from computer.
receive.tooManyAttempts: Too many wrong pairing codes. Try again in a minute.
receive.busy: The TV is already installing a package. Try again when it's done.
receive.certificateRequired: This TV needs a Samsung certificate first. Open TizenBrew Installer on the TV and install something once to create it.

apps.tizenTubeDesc: YouTube without ads. Adds it to TizenBrew.
apps.tizenTubeDescInstall: YouTube without ads. Installs TizenBrew with TizenTube.

wizard.findTitle: Which TV do you want to set up?
wizard.findText: Turn on the TV and make sure it's on the same network as this computer.
wizard.searching: Looking for Samsung TVs on your network...
wizard.noneFound: No Samsung TV found. Is the TV on (not in standby) and on the same network? You can also enter its IP address (Settings > General > Network > Network status > IP settings).
wizard.manualIp: Or enter the IP address of the TV
wizard.devmode2: Type 12345 on the remote. No number keys? Use the 123 button or the button with three dots.
wizard.devmode4: Enter this as Host PC IP and press OK:
wizard.currentIp: Host PC IP on the TV: {{ip}}
wizard.noIp: No Host PC IP set yet
wizard.tvUnreachable: The TV doesn't respond. Is it on?
wizard.watching: Watching the TV, this updates by itself...
wizard.restartText: Hold the power button on the remote until the screen goes black and you see the Samsung logo. Then wait until the TV has fully started.
wizard.frameHint: This is a Frame TV: a short press only switches to Art Mode, which doesn't count as a restart. Keep holding the button, or pull the plug for 30 seconds.
wizard.notRestarted: The TV doesn't accept this computer yet. It probably hasn't fully restarted.
wizard.installTitle: What do you want on your TV?
wizard.installText: After this you can install and update everything from the TV itself.
wizard.appInstallerText: Installs and updates apps on the TV, no computer needed.
wizard.appTizenBrewText: Modules for your TV, like YouTube without ads.
wizard.samsungAccountHint: This TV is from 2023 or newer. You'll sign in once with a Samsung account to create a certificate.
wizard.connectionLost: The connection with the TV was lost.
wizard.resetTitle: Almost done: set the Host PC IP back
wizard.reset2: Change the Host PC IP to
wizard.reset3: Restart the TV again by holding the power button until the Samsung logo.
wizard.resetWhy: TizenBrew and the installer use Developer mode from the TV itself. After this you no longer need this computer.
wizard.doneText: Open TizenBrew Installer on the TV for Streamy, TizenTube and more.
wizard.doneRestart: Restart the TV once more if you haven't yet. You can close this window.
